# EDGAR filings browser: filing-feed (EDGAR)

The filings browser: the latest SEC filings of the covered companies, of every form or one; a click opens a filing beside. One row per edgar filings browser, keyed by FEED. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (table `<root>/us-equities/filing-feed/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (tools/publicdata/us_equities.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 6 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/filing-feed/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `FEED` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `FEED`, `NAME`, `FILINGS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FEED` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | — | `"10-K"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The feed's name: Every form, Annual reports (10-K), Quarterly reports (10-Q), Current reports (8-K), Insider transactions (Form 4) or Proxy statements (DEF 14A). | — | `"Annual reports"` |
| `FORM` | string | optional (filled in 83% of rows) | The SEC form type the feed shows; empty for the feed of every form (ALL). | — | `"10-K"` |
| `FILINGS` | integer | required | How many filings ROWS holds (the latest filings, at most 300). | seen: `300`, `13`, `36` | `13` |
| `COMPANIES` | integer | required | How many different companies filed the filings in ROWS. | — | `13` |
| `LATEST` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The filing date of the newest filing in ROWS, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-23"` |
| `EARLIEST` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The filing date of the oldest filing in ROWS, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-08-05"` |
| `ROWS` | array of objects | required | The feed's filings, newest first, one element each: ACCESSION, FILED, COMPANY, COMPANY_NAME, FORM and DESCRIPTION. | — | [13 objects] |
| `ROWS[].ACCESSION` | string | required | The SEC accession number of the filing: the filing record's key. | — | `"0001628280-26-067038"` |
| `ROWS[].FILED` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the filing was filed (YYYY-MM-DD). | — | `"2026-10-23"` |
| `ROWS[].COMPANY` | string | required | The filer: a TICKER of the us-company kind. | links to `us-company` | `"JBL"` |
| `ROWS[].COMPANY_NAME` | string | required | The filer's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). | — | `"Jabil"` |
| `ROWS[].FORM` | string | required | The SEC form type. | — | `"10-K"` |
| `ROWS[].DESCRIPTION` | string | required | The form type in words. | — | `"Annual report"` |
| `BY` | array of objects | required | The filings counted by form (the ALL feed) or by company (a form's feed), at most 15, most first: LABEL and VALUE (a count); BY_TITLE says which. | — | [13 objects] |
| `BY[].LABEL` | string | required | A form type (the ALL feed) or a company ticker (a one-form feed). | — | `"ACN"` |
| `BY[].VALUE` | integer | required | How many of the feed's filings have that form or company (the 15 largest). | — | `1` |
| `BY_TITLE` | string | required | The title of the BY chart: Filings by form (the ALL feed) or Filings by company. | seen: `Filings by company`, `Filings by form` | `"Filings by company"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the feed comes from, one object: SOURCE (SEC EDGAR submissions), RETRIEVED_AT (YYYY-MM-DD) and LICENCE. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The public source the feed is built from (SEC EDGAR submissions). | — | `"U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR (submission…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the source was retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD). | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The licence of the source. | — | `"Public domain (U.S. Government work); SEC EDGAR fair acces…` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"sec-edgar"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"submissions (recent filings)"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `_meta.licence` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The licence of the source data. | — | `"public domain"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 6 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `FEED` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `FEED`, `NAME`, `FILINGS`, `COMPANIES`, `LATEST`, `EARLIEST`, `ROWS`, `BY`, `BY_TITLE`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `FEED` per snapshot.
